name: Drayage delivery, priced in florins
summary: The last road leg from the port to the consignee, priced and bonded in florins.
description: A single order over the drayage-delivery agreement, unchanged: a trucker carries a container from the port to the consignee by freight class, the hand-off recorded at arrival, and both parties bond before the leg. One term is added. The designer pins the florin, the token that rewards the designers of clauses, agreements and processes, as the one token the order is priced and bonded in. Checkout writes the florin into the agreement, so no token picker appears. This is the designer's choice, not the protocol's: the drayage-delivery agreement stays open to any ERC-20 token in every design that composes it without the pin.
